name: print-social-green-and-lime-agency-post-set-in-phone-and-cards
title: Green agency posts with lime cards, condensed headlines and an eyeball mascot
whatItIs: A pale green field with a phone showing an Instagram feed post and a grid of six posts in deep green, lime and cream. They use big condensed and rounded headlines, small pill tags, photo cutouts of smiling professionals, a big '40+' stat block and a pink blob mascot with eyes for a hiring post.
whatItMeans: Friendly and confident; green-lime palettes feel fresh and modern for an agency.
techniques: Mix condensed headlines with rounded ones.
Add a mascot for the hiring post.
Use lime blocks for stats and green for photos.
Show the set beside a phone.

vocabulary.definition: A post starring a brand character.
A block with one large number.
A small label on a post.
An image showing a series together.
